faqs.question: What services does CloudNexus provide?
faqs.answer: CloudNexus provides 20+ services across 3 categories: Intelligent Automation (AI/ML, Digital Transformation, Cybersecurity, Technology Consulting), Software Engineering (Mobile Apps, Web Development, Software Development, MVP, Hire Developers, UI/UX, SaaS, IT Consulting), and Digital Automation (Product Engineering, E-Commerce, WordPress, Digital Marketing, Cloud Services, DevOps).

faqs.question: How long does a typical project take?
faqs.answer: Timelines vary: simple apps take 4-8 weeks, web applications take 2-4 months, mobile apps take 3-6 months, and enterprise solutions take 6-12 months. We provide detailed timelines during the free consultation.

faqs.question: Do you work with startups or only enterprises?
faqs.answer: We work with both — from early-stage startups to Fortune 500 companies. We have partnered with YC, Tiger Global, and Accel-backed ventures as well as large enterprises.

faqs.question: What industries do you specialize in?
faqs.answer: We serve 15+ industries: Healthcare, E-Commerce, Fintech, Education, Real Estate, Logistics, Media, Manufacturing, Banking & Finance, Travel, Oil & Gas, Social Networking, On-Demand Delivery, Home Service, and mCommerce.

faqs.question: How do you ensure quality, security, and reliability?
faqs.answer: Through Agile methodology, CI/CD pipelines, code reviews, automated testing, performance checks, security audits, and continuous validation. We are compliant with HIPAA, SOC 2, and GDPR.

faqs.question: What is your pricing model?
faqs.answer: We offer three flexible models: Fixed-price (best for defined scope), Time & Material (best for evolving requirements), and Dedicated Teams (best for ongoing development). Contact us for a personalized estimate.

faqs.question: Do you provide post-launch support?
faqs.answer: Yes — we provide bug fixes, monitoring, security updates, feature enhancements, and 24/7 support based on your SLA. We stay engaged post-launch.

faqs.question: What tech stack does CloudNexus use?
faqs.answer: React, Next.js, Node.js, Python, Flutter, React Native, AWS, Azure, GCP, Docker, Kubernetes, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, and more. We pick the best tools for each specific project.

faqs.question: Can CloudNexus help migrate my application to the cloud?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. We handle end-to-end cloud migration — infrastructure assessment, architecture redesign, data migration, and post-migration optimization on AWS, Azure, or GCP.

faqs.question: Do you offer AI and Machine Learning solutions?
faqs.answer: Yes — from computer vision and NLP to predictive analytics, recommendation engines, and custom AI model training. We build production-ready AI solutions tailored to your business.

faqs.question: How can I get a free consultation?
faqs.answer: Visit cloudnexus.in/resources/free-consultation or click 'Join Now' in the navigation. Book a free 30-minute strategy session — no commitment, no cost. Our experts will assess your needs and recommend the best path forward.

faqs.question: What is your development process?
faqs.answer: Discovery & consultation → Requirement analysis → UI/UX design → Agile development (2-week sprints) → QA & testing → Deployment → Post-launch support. Every step is transparent with regular check-ins.

faqs.question: Do you build mobile apps for both iOS and Android?
faqs.answer: Yes — we build native apps (Swift for iOS, Kotlin for Android) and cross-platform apps (Flutter, React Native). We help you choose the right approach based on your budget, timeline, and user needs.

faqs.question: Where is CloudNexus located?
faqs.answer: CloudNexus is headquartered in Bhopal, India, with development centers in Hyderabad and Bengaluru. We serve clients globally and work across different time zones.

faqs.question: How do you communicate during a project?
faqs.answer: Through daily standups, sprint reports, and transparent communication channels — ensuring full visibility and regular client updates at every stage. We use tools like Jira, Slack, and Confluence.
